Cockroaches are nocturnal. If you see one during daylight hours, it means the colony is so large they are being pushed out. There are hundreds more hiding.

2️⃣ You hear scratching inside walls at night
Rats and mice are active after dark. Scratching, scurrying sounds inside walls or ceilings means a rodent nest is already established inside your home.

3️⃣ You find small mud tubes along walls or skirting
These pencil-thin mud tubes are termite highways. If you see them, a termite colony is already active — potentially for months.

4️⃣ You wake up with unexplained bites
Bed bugs feed while you sleep. Small red bites in a line or cluster on your arms, neck, or legs are a classic sign — especially after buying second-hand furniture or returning from travel.

Rodent droppings near food storage areas means contamination has already started. This is a serious health risk especially for families with children.
